balance.title: Balances
settlement.title: Settlement Proposal
settlement.how_desc: The settlement proposal minimizes the number of necessary transfers and considers settlement groups (e.g. families or couples who want to settle together).
settlement.step1_formula: Balance = (Deposits + Private Expenses) - Share of common expenses
settlement.step1_example: Sven spent €1,137.13 and owes €290.35 share → Balance: +€846.78
settlement.step2_desc: Families or couples can be combined into settlement groups. Individual balances are summed and settled through the group representative.
settlement.step2_example: Sven (+€846.78) and Hanni (-€290.35) form the group "Niederheides"
settlement.step2_result: Group balance: +€556.43 (settled through Sven as representative)
settlement.step3_desc: A greedy algorithm minimizes the number of transfers by always matching the largest credit with the largest debt.
settlement.step3_benefit: Minimal number of transactions - each person transfers at most once or receives at most once.
settlement.currency_note: All amounts are calculated in euros. Expenses in other currencies are automatically converted at the daily rate. Rounding differences of a few cents may occur.
settlement.hint_desc: This is the optimized settlement proposal with minimal transfers. Each person only transfers once.

logbook.ios_gps_settings:
📱 iPhone/iPad Settings:

1. Open the Settings app
2. Scroll down to "Safari"
3. Tap "Location"
4. Select "While Using the App"
5. Reload this page

Or in Safari directly:
• Tap "aA" in the address bar
• Select "Website Settings"
• Enable "Location"
logbook.android_gps_settings:
📱 Android Chrome Settings:

1. Tap the 3 dots (⋮) at the top right
2. Select "Settings"
3. Tap "Site Settings"
4. Tap "Location"
5. Make sure Location is enabled
6. Reload this page

Or quickly:
• Tap the 🔒 icon in the address bar
• Select "Permissions"
• Enable "Location"
logbook.safari_gps_settings:
💻 Safari Desktop Settings:

1. Go to Safari > Preferences
2. Click "Websites"
3. Select "Location" in the left list
4. Enable location for this site
5. Reload this page
logbook.browser_gps_settings:
💻 Browser Settings:

Chrome/Edge:
1. Click the 🔒 icon in the address bar
2. Select "Site Settings"
3. Change "Location" to "Allow"
4. Reload this page

Firefox:
1. Click the ⓘ icon in the address bar
2. Click "Connection secure"
3. Click "More Information"
4. Select "Permissions"
5. Enable "Location"
